title: Melody Wright: I'm Out of Stocks — Only Holding Gold, Silver & Cash
speaker: Melody Wright (guest), host Darrell Thomas

macro_themes.theme: AI data center story propping up economy
macro_themes.view: The AI data-center buildout is the only thing holding the economy up, and growing delays and pull-outs will widen the cracks.

macro_themes.theme: Long-end yields rising / Fed lost control
macro_themes.view: The Fed lost control of the long end in Sept 2024; she would not buy long Treasuries, only T-bills ('T-bill and chill').
Housing is oversupplied, foreclosures are rising from lows, and home prices will fall significantly over several years toward ~3x median income.
Near-term high prices (gas, food) push CPI up, but demand destruction and falling rents/home prices should counter it around Q2 next year.
Long energy is the next big story longer term, but it is too volatile now and she is waiting for confirmation.

calls.reason: Market trades on momentum and narrative, not fundamentals; AI data-center cracks and weak economy should bring a correction, though timing could take a while.
calls.quote: I do believe we will get some kind of correction in the stock market. still take some time.

calls.condition: If a broad correction brings selling everywhere, she would buy more gold on the dip.
calls.reason: Gold is central to any debt solution (possible gold-backed bonds), but speculation means a correction could hit it short term.
calls.quote: long term, I'm a fan... I'm just kind of nervous right here... I'll be buying

calls.reason: Holds only gold, silver and cash; silver bias implied by her positioning, not argued separately.
calls.quote: I'm out of the markets, except for gold and silver, and the rest is cash.

notes: Guest is a housing/mortgage analyst, not a trader; calls are positioning, not timed. Silver call inferred only from her holdings. No price levels given. Energy/uranium bullish long term but no specific ticker, so kept in macro_themes.
